name: Birthing on Country Scholarship (SCU Honours)
summary: $10,000 for an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander recent graduate doing the Bachelor of Health and Human Sciences (Honours) at SCU.
who: Identify as an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
Meet entry requirements for the Bachelor of Health and Human Sciences (Honours), full-time.
Graduated from SCU or another university in the last five years.
Willing to be based at the Gold Coast or Coffs Harbour campus.
how: Apply through the online form linked from the scholarship page.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Birthing on Country Scholarship

evidence.quote: Applicants must identify as an Aboriginal person and/or Torres Strait Islander person.
